description: Test suite for concept vocabulary functions, including extraction of multilingual concept tags and their classification based on script family.

methods.name: classifyConceptTagScript
methods.description: Classifies a concept tag based on its script family (e.g., Latin, CJK, or mixed).

methods.name: deriveConceptTags
methods.description: Extracts concept tags from a text snippet, supporting multilingual and multi-script detection.

methods.name: summarizeConceptTagScriptCoverage
methods.description: Provides a summary counting entries classified into Latin, CJK, mixed, or other script families.
